links.outcome: Faithfulness, relevancy and clinical caution of grounded vs ungrounded LLM configurations
links.effect: Fine-tuned RAG achieved RAGAS faithfulness 0.91, response relevancy 0.88, DeepEval answer relevancy 0.90, clinical caution 0.93, outperforming base LLM, base RAG, and fine-tuned non-RAG.
links.quote: In generation-stage evaluation, the fine-tuned RAG configuration achieved a RAGAS faithfulness score of 0.91, response relevancy of 0.88, DeepEval answer relevancy of 0.90, and clinical caution score of 0.93, outperforming the base LLM, base RAG, and fine-tuned non-RAG configurations.

unlisted_practices: Building a localized non-English medical corpus with deduplication and quality filtering for fine-tuning
Retrieval hit-rate evaluation (Hit Rate@k) of a RAG system

screen.practice: retrieval grounding added to base and fine-tuned LLM
screen.reason: The study develops TurkishMedLLM and empirically evaluates the addition of retrieval-augmented generation (comparing base LLM, base RAG, fine-tuned non-RAG, and fine-tuned RAG) on faithfulness, relevancy, and clinical caution metrics.
